_comment: Plate spec for the locked Scene 1 living-room plate.
Boxes are normalised [x0, y0, x1, y1] against the plate's own frame, so a
candidate frame of any resolution or aspect can be compared to it.
Everything here is measured off the plate itself - the plate is the source
of truth, this file only says WHERE to look and HOW CLOSE is close enough.
_bands_comment: Left/right bands for the mirror test. The locked staging puts the TV in the left band and Jenny's armchair in the right band; a flipped room scores better crossed than straight.
_swatches_comment: Small patches sampled off the plate. Used for wardrobe presence and for the couch upholstery reference that couch occupancy subtracts.
_wardrobe_comment: Which manifest character each swatch stands for. Only characters with a
swatch are checkable; the rest are reported n/a rather than silently passed.
A swatch is ALSO rejected at load time if its colour covers more than
swatch_max_plate_coverage of the plate - see that threshold. In practice
that disqualifies Nina's black dress, Gabe's black tux and Jenny's grey-blue
hoodie: in a dim room those colours are most of the frame, so their
'coverage' measures the lighting, not the costume. They stay listed here so
the reason they are skipped is visible, not silently absent.
